Dear Editor,
It seems that every time one opens the opinion page one is confronted with narratives that play on one's emotions and calling out the latest boogeyman and ... of course ... it is "the other."

item.description:

item.title: FOR YOUR HEALTH: What to know about dementia, how to prevent it | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: Dementia touches many lives in many different ways, and most of us likely have some firsthand experience with it, whether it's with an aging family member, friend or neighbor.
